newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-EVANS SUES MERLE OVER HEAD BUTT.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-EVANS SUES MERLE OVER HEAD BUTT.

text.p: Former Wales prop Ricky Evans said on Friday he was suing French international Olivier Merle after sustaining serious injuries in a head-butting incident during a Five Nations match nearly two years ago.
Evans served a writ in the French high court claiming damages for the injuries he received, loss of earnings and medical expenses.
The Llanelli player suffered a double fracture of the leg, ligament damage in his left ankle and a broken nose during a match at the Parc des Princes in January 1995.

Evans was out for four-and-a-half months, missing three internationals. He returned to World Cup action but needed further surgery and missed the first half of the following season, losing his place in the Welsh side.

"French law would say that Mr Evans consented to a reasonable risk of a rugby injury when he played in that game. He did not consent to being head-butted when he was looking the other way," said Evans's lawyer Mark Harvey.
